lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ghar 5 mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth House, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੀਤਰਿ ਪੰਚ ਗੁਪਤ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਸੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bheetar pa(n)ch gupat man vaase ||
lines.translation: The five evil passions dwell hidden within the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਹਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਭਵਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: thir na rahahi jaise bhavahi udaase ||1||
lines.translation: They do not remain still, but move around like wanderers. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: man meraa daiaal setee thir na rahai ||
lines.translation: My soul does not stay held by the Merciful Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਭੀ ਕਪਟੀ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਖੰਡੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਧਿਕ ਲਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: lobhee kapatee paapee paakha(n)dee maaiaa adhik lagai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: It is greedy, deceitful, sinful and hypocritical, and totally attached to Maya. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫੂਲ ਮਾਲਾ ਗਲਿ ਪਹਿਰਉਗੀ ਹਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: phool maalaa gal pahiraugee haaro ||
lines.translation: I will decorate my neck with garlands of flowers.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੈਗਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਤਬ ਕਰਉਗੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੋ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: milaigaa preetam tab karaugee seegaaro ||2||
lines.translation: When I meet my Beloved, then I will put on my decorations. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਸਖੀ ਹਮ ਏਕੁ ਭਤਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch sakhee ham ek bhataaro ||
lines.translation: I have five companions and one Spouse.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੇਡਿ ਲਗੀ ਹੈ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਚਾਲਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ped lagee hai jeeaRaa chaalanahaaro ||3||
lines.translation: It is ordained from the very beginning, that the soul must ultimately depart. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਸਖੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਰੁਦਨੁ ਕਰੇਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch sakhee mil rudan karehaa ||
lines.translation: The five companions will lament together.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹੁ ਪਜੂਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਖਾ ਦੇਹਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੪॥
lines.transliteration: saahu pajootaa pranavat naanak lekhaa dehaa ||4||1||34||
lines.translation: When the soul is trapped, prays Nanak, it is called to account. ||4||1||34||

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੬ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ghar 6 mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Sixth House, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮੋਤੀ ਜੇ ਗਹਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਉਣੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੂਤ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: man motee je gahanaa hovai paun hovai soot dhaaree ||
lines.translation: If the pearl of the mind is strung like a jewel on the thread of the breath,

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਮਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਤਨਿ ਪਹਿਰੈ ਰਾਵੈ ਲਾਲ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: khimaa seegaar kaaman tan pahirai raavai laal piaaree ||1||
lines.translation: and the soul-bride adorns her body with compassion, then the Beloved Lord will enjoy His lovely bride. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਲ ਬਹੁ ਗੁਣਿ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਮੋਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: laal bahu gun kaaman mohee ||
lines.translation: O my Love, I am fascinated by Your many glories;

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਹੋਹਿ ਨ ਅਵਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tere gun hohi na avaree ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Your Glorious Virtues are not found in any other. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਲੇ ਪਹਿਰੈ ਦਾਮੋਦਰੁ ਦੰਤੁ ਲੇਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har haar ka(n)th le pahirai daamodar da(n)t leee ||
lines.translation: If the bride wears the garland of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, around her neck, and if she uses the toothbrush of the Lord;

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਕੰਗਨ ਪਹਿਰੈ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਧਰੇਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kar kar karataa ka(n)gan pahirai in bidh chit dhareee ||2||
lines.translation: and if she fashions and wears the bracelet of the Creator Lord around her wrist, then she shall hold her consciousness steady. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੁ ਕਰ ਮੁੰਦਰੀ ਪਹਿਰੈ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਪਟੁ ਲੇਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: madhusoodan kar mu(n)daree pahirai paramesar pat leee ||
lines.translation: She should make the Lord, the Slayer of demons, her ring, and take the Transcendent Lord as her silken clothes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੀਰਜੁ ਧੜੀ ਬੰਧਾਵੈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗੁ ਸੁਰਮਾ ਦੇਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: dheeraj dhaRee ba(n)dhaavai kaaman sreera(n)g suramaa deee ||3||
lines.translation: The soul-bride should weave patience into the braids of her hair, and apply the lotion of the Lord, the Great Lover. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਜੇ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਜਾਲੇ ਕਾਇਆ ਸੇਜ ਕਰੇਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: man ma(n)dar je deepak jaale kaaiaa sej kareee ||
lines.translation: If she lights the lamp in the mansion of her mind, and makes her body the bed of the Lord,

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਰਾਉ ਜਬ ਸੇਜੈ ਆਵੈ ਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੋਗੁ ਕਰੇਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੫॥
lines.transliteration: giaan raau jab sejai aavai ta naanak bhog kareee ||4||1||35||
lines.translation: then, when the King of spiritual wisdom comes to her bed, He shall take her, and enjoy her. ||4||1||35||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: keetaa hovai kare karaaiaa tis kiaa kaheeai bhaaee ||
lines.translation: The created being acts as he is made to act; what can be said to him, O Siblings of Destiny?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਕੀਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karanaa so kar rahiaa keete kiaa chaturaaee ||1||
lines.translation: Whatever the Lord is to do, He is doing; what cleverness could be used to affect Him? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਭਲਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa hukam bhalaa tudh bhaavai ||
lines.translation: The Order of Your Will is so sweet, O Lord; this is pleasing to You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak taa kau milai vadaaee saache naam samaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, he alone is honored with greatness, who is absorbed in the True Name. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kirat paiaa paravaanaa likhiaa baahuR hukam na hoee ||
lines.translation: The deeds are done according to pre-ordained destiny; no one can turn back this Order.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤੈਸਾ ਪੜਿਆ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jaisaa likhiaa taisaa paRiaa met na sakai koee ||2||
lines.translation: As it is written, so it comes to pass; no one can erase it. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਦਰਗਹ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਬੋਲੈ ਨਾਉ ਪਵੈ ਬਾਜਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: je ko daragah bahutaa bolai naau pavai baajaaree ||
lines.translation: He who talks on and on in the Lord's Court is known as a joker.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਰੰਜ ਬਾਜੀ ਪਕੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਚੀ ਆਵੈ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: satara(n)j baajee pakai naahee kachee aavai saaree ||3||
lines.translation: He is not successful in the game of chess, and his chessmen do not reach their goal. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਪੜਿਆ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਬੀਨਾ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa ko paRiaa pa(n)dit beenaa naa ko moorakh ma(n)daa ||
lines.translation: By himself, no one is literate, learned or wise; no one is ignorant or evil.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੰਦੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਹੀਐ ਬੰਦਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੩੬॥
lines.transliteration: ba(n)dee a(n)dar siphat karaae taa kau kaheeai ba(n)daa ||4||2||36||
lines.translation: When, as a slave, one praises the Lord, only then is he known as a human being. ||4||2||36||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਖਿਮਾ ਹਢਾਵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad manai mahi mu(n)draa khi(n)thaa khimaa hadhaavau ||
lines.translation: Let the Word of the Guru's Shabad be the ear-rings in your mind, and wear the patched coat of tolerance.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਉ ਸਹਜ ਜੋਗ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karai bhalaa kar maanau sahaj jog nidh paavau ||1||
lines.translation: Whatever the Lord does, look upon that as good; thus you shall obtain the treasure of Sehj Yoga. ||1||
